new_products.Title: Magic Cube Display Pro
new_products.Sub Title: Professional in-wall display for Magic Cube ecosystems
new_products.Product Description: The Magic Cube Display Pro is Innovo's professional in-wall display companion for the Magic Cube Aura controller. It pairs the visual polish of a dedicated touchscreen with the open-source Magic Cube driver ecosystem, giving integrators a flexible front-of-wall surface for lighting, climate, shading, audio, and security scenes across Nice, Control4, Lutron, and Rako-based projects. The device is sold through the Innovo dealer channel and is designed to slot alongside the Aura hub and the rest of the Magic Cube hardware family. Like the rest of the Magic Cube line, the Display Pro is targeted at professional residential integrators and benefits from the same active driver development and community knowledge base that powers the broader Innovo platform, allowing dealers to standardize on a single interface across multi-protocol smart-home deployments.

new_products.Title: Magic Cube POE Driver
new_products.Sub Title: Power-over-Ethernet driver module for the Magic Cube
new_products.Product Description: The Magic Cube POE Driver gives integrators a clean, single-cable power option for any Magic Cube Aura installation. Instead of relying on the supplied wall power supply or PoE injector, the POE driver lets the Magic Cube draw both power and network from a single Cat5e/Cat6 run back to a PoE-capable switch, which simplifies rack and in-cabinet installs and removes the need for an extra outlet near the device. It is sold as part of the Innovo accessory line alongside other Magic Cube power and network add-ons, and is intended for professional dealers building Nice, Control4, Lutron, or Rako control systems on the Magic Cube platform.

new_products.Title: Magic Cube Aura Rack Mount Kit
new_products.Sub Title: 1U rack-mount kit for the Magic Cube Aura controller
new_products.Product Description: The Magic Cube Aura Rack Mount Kit is a purpose-made bracket assembly that lets integrators install one or more Magic Cube Aura controllers into a standard equipment rack. It keeps the Aura tidy alongside the rest of the AV and network gear in a closet or central rack and provides repeatable mounting for multi-Aura deployments. The kit is part of the Innovo accessory range and is aimed at professional dealers standardizing on the Magic Cube ecosystem for whole-home control, automation and IoT bridging duties. As with the rest of the Innovo line it is sold only through approved dealers and not at retail.
